name: ru_sci_bench_translation_search
description: A specialized dataset that evaluates models' ability to translate Russian scientific/search queries and related text into target languages while preserving domain-specific terminology. It measures translation quality in the context of scientific information retrieval and search tasks, focusing on fidelity of technical terms and query intent. Useful for assessing models intended for cross-lingual scientific search and discovery.
reputation: A small, domain-specific Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing use among researchers working on Russian-to-other-language scientific translation and search.
